rental.title: Rental
rental.lead: What is agreed when you hire reception equipment: booking, delivery, collection, breakage and cancellation.
rental.pendingBody: The process described below is the one TBS actually follows.
rental.pendingCount: One commercial figure — deposit, security deposit, cancellation periods — has yet to be set. | {n} commercial figures — deposit, security deposit, cancellation periods — have yet to be set.
rental.pendingPrevails: Until then, **only the accepted quote is binding**.
rental.purposeBody: These terms govern the hire of reception equipment from TBS Distribution S.A.R.L — furniture, tableware, linen, decoration, sound and lighting — together with the associated delivery, set-up and collection services.
rental.purposeQuote: They supplement the accepted quote. **In case of any discrepancy, the quote prevails**: it carries the detailed equipment list, the dates, the venue and the firm price agreed.
rental.bookingQuote: Every enquiry gives rise to a priced quote, sent within 24 working hours. The quote sets out the inventory, the quantities, the delivery and collection dates, the venue and the total amount.
rental.bookingFirm: The booking becomes firm once the quote is accepted in writing and the deposit is paid. Equipment is only held from that point on: in high season, an unconfirmed quote guarantees no availability.
rental.amountsIntro: The following figures apply to every hire, unless the quote states otherwise:
rental.amountsRefund: The security deposit is refunded after the equipment has been collected and checked, less any missing or damaged items.
rental.deliveryBody: TBS delivers, sets up and arranges the equipment before the agreed time, then dismantles and collects it after the event. The time slots are stated on the quote.
rental.deliveryAccess: The client guarantees practicable access to the venue — a passable road, an unloading area, a clear set-up space — and the presence of a contact person at both delivery and collection. If access proves impossible or the space has not been cleared, waiting time and a second visit are charged.
rental.useOwnership: The equipment remains the property of TBS Distribution S.A.R.L for the whole hire period. It may not be sub-let, lent, moved away from the venue stated on the quote, or modified.
rental.useCare: It is supplied washed, checked and counted. The client takes reasonable care of it and protects it from the weather and from damage throughout the hire period.
rental.breakage: Breakage, missing items and late returns
rental.breakageInventory: A joint inventory is drawn up at delivery and at collection. Equipment that is missing, broken or rendered unusable is charged on the basis set out in the table above.
rental.breakageWear: Normal wear and tear is not charged. A stained tablecloth is cleaned by TBS; a torn or burnt one is replaced.
rental.breakageLate: Any equipment not returned on the agreed date extends the hire and is charged at the daily rate until it is actually returned.
rental.cancellationNotice: Any cancellation must be notified in writing — by e-mail or WhatsApp message — as early as possible. The applicable periods and retained amounts are set out in the table above.
rental.cancellationPostpone: Postponement to a later date is accepted free of charge subject to availability, provided it is requested within the free cancellation period.
rental.cancellationByTbs: Should TBS be unable to carry out the service, all sums paid are refunded in full, with no further compensation.
rental.liabilityTbs: TBS is answerable for the conformity of the equipment delivered and for the proper execution of the set-up. Its liability is limited to the amount of the hire concerned and does not cover indirect loss.
rental.liabilityClient: The client is answerable for the equipment from delivery until collection, including in the event of theft, damage by a third party or bad weather. It is for the client to check that their insurance covers the event.
rental.liabilityForce: Neither party is held liable for a failure caused by force majeure.
rental.claimsBody: Any complaint must be notified within 48 hours of collection, by e-mail to [{email}](mailto:{email}) or by telephone on [{phone}](tel:{phoneHref}). After that period the service is deemed accepted.
rental.dataBody: Information provided with a quote request is processed in accordance with the [privacy policy](/confidentialite).
rental.lawBody: These terms are governed by **Togolese law**. In the event of a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution. Failing agreement, the dispute falls to the **competent courts of Lomé**.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What we record when you request a quote, why, for how long, and how to have it erased.
privacy.summaryBody: This site sets **no cookies**, uses no web analytics tool and carries no targeted advertising. The only data collection happens when you voluntarily fill in the quote request form.
privacy.summaryAnalytics: One exception: a **cookie-free analytics measure with no individual identifier** counts the pages viewed. It cannot recognise you from one visit to the next. Details under “Cookies and trackers”.
privacy.controllerIdentity: Full details of the company appear on the [legal notice](/mentions-legales) page.
collectedYouItems: **Name** and **telephone number** — required, as these are what allow us to call you back;
**E-mail address** — optional, so we can send you the written proposal;
**Event date**, **number of guests** and **venue** — optional, to size the offer;
collectedServerItems: A **fingerprint of your IP address** — the address itself is never stored in the clear: only an irreversible cryptographic fingerprint is, in order to cap the number of requests per hour and turn away automated submissions;
Your browser identifier (**user-agent**), for the same purpose.
privacy.collectedServerUse: These two items serve solely to protect the form against abuse. They are neither used for commercial purposes nor passed on to third parties, and they do not appear in the messages sent to the team.
purposesItems: **Answering your quote request** — processing necessary to take pre-contractual steps at your request;
**Protecting the form against abuse** — TBS's legitimate interest in keeping its site working properly;
**Keeping a record of commercial exchanges** — legitimate interest, and compliance with accounting obligations where a hire is actually concluded.
privacy.purposesNoProspecting: No data is used for unsolicited marketing.
privacy.recipientsIntro: Requests are accessible only to the people at TBS Distribution S.A.R.L who handle quotes. They pass through technical providers acting on our instructions:
privacy.recipientsNone: To date, **no database and no mail delivery service is connected to the site**: a request sent from the form is neither recorded nor forwarded by e-mail. This list will be revised the day either one goes into service. No data is sold, rented or exchanged.
privacy.retentionCaveat: What follows describes the processing as it will apply once the database is connected. For as long as it is not, nothing is retained.
privacy.retentionBody: Quote requests are kept for **{months} months** from the last exchange, then anonymised: name, telephone number, e-mail address, venue, description of needs and technical items are erased. All that remains is the business line, the type of request and the dates — statistics with no link to any person.
privacy.retentionAuto: This anonymisation is **automatic**: a scheduled job triggers it every night, and it depends on no manual intervention.
privacy.retentionAccounting: Where a hire is concluded, the related accounting records are kept for the statutory period applicable to commercial documents.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right of **access**, **rectification**, **erasure**, **restriction**, **objection** and **portability** over the data concerning you.
privacy.rightsHow: To exercise them, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}) or call [{phone}](tel:{phoneHref}). You will receive an answer within one month. No justification is required to ask for a quote request to be deleted.
privacy.rightsAuthority: If the answer does not satisfy you, you may refer the matter to the **Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP)**, the Togolese supervisory authority. People residing in the European Union may also refer the matter to the supervisory authority of their country of residence.
privacy.securityBody: The site is served over HTTPS and sends the usual security headers. Quote requests are stored in a database with restricted access, the IP address appears there only as a fingerprint, and the form is protected against automated submissions.
privacy.cookiesBody: The site sets **no cookies** and uses neither local storage nor advertising pixels. No consent banner is needed: there is nothing to consent to.
privacy.cookiesAnalytics: Analytics are provided by **{provider}** ({host}), chosen precisely because it works without cookies and without a persistent identifier. What is counted is the page viewed, the country, the device type and the referrer — never anything that could identify you. A few actions useful for commercial follow-up are also counted: opening the quote form, submitting it, and clicks on the phone numbers and on WhatsApp.
privacy.cookiesNoAnalytics: No analytics tool is in place.
privacy.thirdPartiesMap: The [contact](/contact) page offers a map supplied by **OpenStreetMap**. **It does not load on its own**: nothing is requested from OpenStreetMap until you click “Show the map”. If you do, its servers then receive your IP address and your browser characteristics.
privacy.thirdPartiesNone: No other third-party resource is loaded: fonts, images and scripts are all served from this site.
privacy.changesBody: This policy may change, in particular once the technical providers are settled. The date it was last updated appears at the top of the page.
